clips.prompt: One continuous shot, no cuts. The camera slowly pulls back a little. Flat seamless blue field, identical colour and light, nothing else moves.

Continuing the same slow pull back, no cuts. Flat seamless blue field, identical colour and light, nothing else moves.

Continuing the same slow pull back, no cuts, coming to rest. The loose column of the same seven matte discs straightens until it is one neat stack, every disc level and evenly spaced, perfectly still at the end. No disc leaves, no disc is added. Flat seamless blue field, identical colour and light, nothing else moves.
